From the diary entries for each year that Pepys recorded in December, the naval patron **Edward Montagu, 1st Earl of Sandwich** is cited in every December entry except in the December 1668 entry.

- Page 1 (the “Summary of Tom and Diary” page) lists the December entries for the years 1661‑1669. The name “Montagu” appears in all the December lines except 1668.  
- Page 3 (the full diary text) contains the December 1667 entry “**17 Dec. 17 …**” in which Pepys writes of “Sir Edward **Montagu**” who attended his discussion of naval affairs.

- The November‑December 1669 section on page 5 lists “Sir Edward **Montagu**” again as the patron attending the Admiralty, but the December 1668 text (not shown above) omits him.

Thus, the naval figure mentioned in every December entry apart from December 1668 is **Edward Montagu, 1st Earl of Sandwich**.
